script_text: Pisces, the cosmos is about to turn your love life upside down this week—brace yourself. As Mercury retrograde lingers in Cancer in your 5th House of romance through Wednesday, misunderstandings with partners surface, making Monday worst for heart talks. Yet the Sun’s trine to Neptune in Aries in your 2nd House on Tuesday sparks intuitive career money moves. The key shift hits Thursday when Venus enters Leo, lighting your 6th House of work and clearing retrograde haze. Late week, Mars in Scorpio trines your ascendant on Friday, fueling weekend creativity. Sunday’s Mercury direct in your 5th House resets love. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Jupiter in Leo in your 6th House, boosting career luck. Monday is your worst day as Mercury retrograde squares Saturn in Aries, delaying finances. Your water element feels the tidal pull—review contracts before signing until Mercury clears shadow. Follow for daily updates.
